chase: Closing in down the long hall. Nothing stops it yet.
Each step is small. Together they cover the whole floor.
It is not in a hurry. The hall is long enough.
Following your breathing. Quiet, but not quiet enough.
Your path bends left. It bends with you.
Empty rooms make the easiest places to close the gap.
Round the next corner, then the one after that.
No need to run. The route runs out for you.
Ahead of you now. It took the longer way around.
It keeps the same distance and counts your steps.
Your footsteps arrive a moment after you do.
Keep moving. This hall ends where it started.
Close now. Close enough to feel the cold air move.
Slow and certain. That is how it closes a gap.
Two steps to the wall. No room left to turn.
The gap between you shrinks with every corner you check.
Every stride covers the long hall at once.
It moves in pieces, but the pieces never stop.
The far end of the hall is where it waits.
catch: Caught. Stand still and this will be over quickly.
It takes you by the arm and walks you out.
You are out of the hall now. It is quieter without you.
Caught at the stairs. The stairwell is quiet again.
Taken to the door. The door opens on its own.
Grabbed. Your flashlight rolls under the bench.
The route closes behind you. This exit is sealed.
One of them is out. The rest are still in the hall.
Another one caught. The count drops by one.
Dragged to the cold room. Hold still for the walk.
Your teammate is out. Keep the rest out of reach.
Caught in the open. No corner was ever a shelter.
Taken from the line. The line closes after it.
The catch is clean. Nothing else on this floor moves.
Caught. The walk back to the door is short.
It grips your shoulder and turns you around.
Caught at the door. The hall goes quiet.
Stand still and the walk back will be short.
hear: A sound from the east side. It turns toward it.
Footsteps on the stairs. Checking the source now.
A door somewhere behind the shelves. Going to look.
Something broke in the next room. It is already moving.
A shout on the far floor. Moving toward it now.
Noise near the vents. Air moves when something opens.
A loud click by the locker row. Heading there.
Glass on the tile. The sound carries down the hall.
Too much noise on this floor. It will be checked.
Your voice carried through the vent grille.
Breathing near the back door. Turning toward it.
Rattling in the duct above. Following the sound.
A chair scraped across tile. That is enough.
Something dropped past the stairwell. Investigating now.
Movement at the edge of the map. It goes there.
Two quick steps by the elevator. Closer now.
A door opens in the east wing. It is coming.
Something slammed below. It starts moving.
Footsteps on the back stairs. Moving to check.
search: Lost the trail at the last door. Searching the room.
No sound and no beam. Checking every shelf.
The footsteps stopped. The search goes on.
Sniffing the air by the vents. Still nothing.
Quiet floor. Returning to the patrol route.
The trail went cold near the stairwell.
Every corner checked once. Checking them again.
Lost you at the junction. Searching the rooms.
Nothing under the desks. Nothing behind the crates.
Back to the loop. The hall will be checked again.
The search pattern widens across the floor.
Silence in the east wing. It will keep looking.
No target in sight. Resuming the patrol.
The beam is gone. The room is empty now.
Gone from view. The search runs one room at a time.
It waits by the door until the hall is quiet.
stunned: Stunned. Systems reset in a few seconds.
Held in place. The grip will not last.
Shaking it off. The lights blur for a moment.
Frame shudders. Recovering in a few seconds.
Hit by the taser. Recalibrating now.
The crowbar landed. Recovery is underway.
Struck by the axe. Holding position for now.
Current cut out. Circuits come back slowly.
Stopped in the doorway. Resuming in a moment.
Grip locked. Waiting for the signal to clear.
Two seconds of static. Then movement returns.
Frozen by the charge. It will not stay frozen.
Something hit the joints. Rechecking them now.
Taser contact. Motion is paused until reset.
The hit is logged. Movement comes back shortly.
Staggered, not stopped. It is walking again.
hide_spot: Hiding in the locker. The locker is not a secret.
Hiding under the desk. The desk does not hide you.
A bed is a poor cover. It checks under it anyway.
The locker door is open. Nothing inside it.
Breathing behind the curtain. The curtain is thin.
Checking the wardrobe first. Every spot gets a look.
Under the bunk, then the next one. Thorough.
Walking past the closet. Hiding there does not work.
The cabinet is open. Empty. Moving on.
Hiding spots are checked one at a time.
Nobody hides from the cold for long.
The shelf unit is searched. The gap is small.
Locker checked. Next locker in the row.
Under the cot. Not a good place to hide.
Curtain pulled back. Nothing but dust.
A quiet spot still makes a sound when it is checked.
light: The beam is on the wall. It is already elsewhere.
You turned the flashlight on. It is already noticing.
Light on the floor. The floor is not the problem.
Your beam is a line. The line moves on.
The lamp flickers near it. Noted.
Bright light on the sensor. Logged.
Flashlight pointed here. Logged as a nuisance.
Too much light in the hall. Adjusting for it.
Light in the face of the sensor. Not a threat.
The beam crosses the floor. It is not shaken.
A lit flashlight is noise to it. Nothing more.
The lamp is on again. The room is brighter.
Blinded for a second. It has not stopped.
Dazzled, then steady. The route still holds.
Bright flash across the sensor. Recalibrating.
Light on its shell. It is noticed and ignored.
idle: Patient corner, cold floor, nothing to report.
It likes a room that is warm before anyone enters it.
Every system here has a switch. It knows where each one is.
A hum in the walls is company enough.
Nothing here is too small to switch off.
It counts seconds the way others count coins.
It has never hurried to finish a thought.
Idle is not asleep. It is awake in every wire.
Small things, slowly. That is the rhythm of the floor.
Cool air, dim hall, a long wait. It does not mind.
Two of them, one of you. The odds are fine.
The loud one at the front can have the noise.
You are all too loud. Quiet is better for the work.
Give them room to run. The dark does the rest.
The corner is quiet. Keep the air cool.
Still waiting. The cold is reliable at least.
ability: Flashlight offline. Nine seconds, then it comes back.
Heater off. The cold will come up through your shoes.
The map goes black. Count your steps until it returns.
Your flashlight will not turn on for a few seconds.
One system at a time. Never two, and never for long.
It picks one thing to take, then leaves the rest alone.
Radar dark. The map is a blank page for nine seconds.
The heater clicks off and the room cools by degrees.
Each system returns on its own. Nothing stays broken.
Off for a few seconds. Then the light comes back as it was.
Radar gone. Keep the route in your head for nine seconds.
Systems switch off in turn. Nothing else is touched.
Flashlight cut. Use the dark and keep moving.
The air control clicks off. The room starts to cool.
Cutting power to the radar. It is only temporary.
A system goes dark. Then it returns, exactly as it was.
mechanic: The relay is next. It sits behind the locked panel.
Batteries are kept in the back rooms. Go there last.
Vents carry the cold. It knows every grille.
Doors lock behind you. Count the rooms you passed.
The radar pings once. Then it goes quiet.
Items on the floor are not free. Each has a cost.
Falls on the stairs cost more than steps.
Stairs ahead. It will be waiting at the top.
Sabotage on the panel. One switch at a time.
The vent cover is loose. Crawl through quietly.
Flashlight battery low. Save it for the stairs.
Radar gone. The room is marked by footsteps alone.
Doors stay shut when the power is cut.
The relay hums. Its switch is the one to cut.
Two items in one bin. Pick one and leave.
The panel lights up. The route counts its switches.
The relay is locked behind a panel.
Batteries are stacked in the back rooms.
Each panel unlocks when its relay is charged.
